# Respec Labs

> Respec Labs (respeclabs.com) is a consultancy for games and interactive entertainment, founded by Daniele Nanni, a creative and game director with 25+ years in the games industry. It works with game studios and with companies outside games that need interactive entertainment expertise. It offers consulting and fractional (interim) design leadership, career coaching for professionals, academic advisory for game design schools and programs, and mentoring for students and recent graduates. Tagline: "It's time to level up."

## Founder
- Daniele Nanni (Dan Nanni), Founder & Principal Consultant
- Credits include Starfield, Fallout 76, The Elder Scrolls, Battlefield 4, Killzone 3, and Star Wars Battlefront II
- Studios: Bethesda, EA, Sony, Tencent, Gearbox, Microsoft
- Languages: English and Italian
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/dnanni/

## Services
- Studio Strategist (for game studios, interactive entertainment companies, and businesses building interactive experiences): consulting and fractional design leadership, including team structure, hiring, project direction, scope planning, interim leadership, and managing, training, and mentoring design teams
- Pro Coach (for professionals at every level, working or between jobs): next-role and promotion strategy, leadership growth, résumé and portfolio reviews, interview prep
- Academy Advisor (for game design and interactive media schools and programs): curriculum advising, program consulting, workshops, guest lectures
- Student Mentor (for students and new grads, at a student rate): academic and career direction, project and portfolio feedback, getting hire-ready with résumé reviews and interview prep

## How engagements work
1. Reach out through the contact form or by email; Daniele replies with a link to book a free intro call
2. A plan with goals, priorities, and a scope of work that fits the team, timeline, and budget
3. Hands-on consulting, leadership, coaching, or mentoring with regular check-ins
